title: Your gift is working…
paragraphs:
Your gift is working…
but your soul is drifting.
Because this is where it gets dangerous.

You’re still effective.
Still applauded.
Still “used.”
And here’s the question most people are too afraid to face:
What if your gift is covering a life that is slowly disconnecting from God?
You didn’t forget how to speak, sing, lead, build, influence.
So why does heaven feel silent?
Because the answer will either confront you…

We have created a culture that celebrates visible power
but ignores invisible intimacy.
But heaven is not impressed with performance.

Your gift can function
even when your heart is far from God.
Because gifting is not proof of alignment.

Chosen before birth.
Set apart.
Carried supernatural strength.
“For the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb…” — Judges 13:5
“But he did not know that the LORD had left him.” — Judges 16:20
Let that sink into your bones.

You can still lead
while losing sensitivity.

You can still preach
while neglecting prayer.

You can still minister
while secretly entertaining sin.
Because God never anointed you to perform.
He called you to walk with Him.
Jesus gives a warning that should shake every gifted person:

“Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name… cast out demons… and do many mighty works?’
And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me…’”
— Matthew 7:22–23
Notice what Jesus did NOT say:

He didn’t say,
“You lost your gift.”
Some scholars interpret this as referring to those who operated outwardly in religious acts without genuine saving faith.
You can be around spiritual activity…
and still not belong to Christ.
Because it exposes the lie before it’s too late.
✝️ GOSPEL TURN — THIS IS WHERE GRACE ENTERS
This is not a message to condemn you.
This is a call to bring you home.
You were lost… and Jesus came for you.
We all choose ourselves over God at times.
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23
But God didn’t leave us there.
Jesus lived the perfect life you couldn’t live.
He died the death you deserved.
“But God shows His love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8
He didn’t just forgive performance failures.
So you don’t have to live disconnected anymore.
“If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us…” — 1 John 1:9

Your calling is not sustained by your gifting.
It is sustained by your relationship with Jesus.

When was the last time you sat with God…
not to prepare something…
When was the last time conviction moved you?
When was the last time you said:
Because this is where everything shifts.
You don’t need a new platform.
You don’t need a bigger audience.
Because calling is always rooted in love.
If something in you is being stirred…

“Jesus… I don’t want to just be gifted.
I want to be Yours.”
Lay down what you’ve been hiding.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
